title: Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi (Theme 3: Mahusiano)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names the text styles and typing symbols (herufi nzito, mlazo, kupigiwa mstari, saizi, @, %) and what each is for.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child labels each style and symbol.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Herufi zinazoegemea upande huitwa herufi ___." Kwa nini "nzito" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Herufi nzito zimenenepeshwa, herufi mlazo huegemea upande, saizi ni ukubwa wa herufi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Herufi zilizonenepeshwa huitwa herufi ___." Kwa nini "kubwa" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Herufi kubwa ni za mwanzo wa sentensi na majina. Herufi nzito ni zilizonenepeshwa, zinaweza kuwa ndogo au kubwa.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kuweka kazi yako salama katika tarakilishi huitwa ___." Kwa nini "kuchapisha" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kuhifadhi ni kuweka kazi salama. Kuchapisha ni kutoa karatasi. Kufuta huondoa kazi.
Alama @ hutumika katika anwani ya baruapepe.

skills.key_step: The child selects the text first and chooses the style by its purpose (title bold, book title italic, key word underlined), then saves.
representations: a model page with styles labelled
steps: Choose the style by its purpose.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child types the paragraph, makes the title bold and one word italic, and saves.

misconceptions.repair: Tumia herufi nzito kwa anwani au neno muhimu tu.
Chagua maandishi kwanza, kisha chagua mtindo.
Majina ya vitabu huandikwa kwa mlazo.

misconceptions.ask: Mabadiliko yako yatabaki ukifunga bila kuhifadhi?

checks.question: Jina la kitabu huandikwa kwa mtindo gani?
Kabla ya kubonyeza B, unafanya nini?
